title: MD8 Update, Shadow Guesser, and other updates

texts: Added the new gifts, choice events, and theme packs (with encounters) for MD8.
Added Crimson God Sinclair. Identity notes and Clash Arena support to be added later.
Clash Arena: Fixed the current draft section not showing the player's draft in Battle Royale mode.
Added support for Excision and Purple coins for skills.
Added some minor prioritization details in the Universal Combos section of the Universal Gifts page. New gifts will be added later
Added new ad placements on the top of most pages.
Made some minor changes and cleanup to the layout of some tools.
